entry_points.text: Namespace control validates and routes owner, parent, type, id, pid and mount requests; membership routes on clone tag; early setup mounts internal instance.
User truncate, chmod, chown, open variants and hangup entries converge on shared helpers with symlink control, privilege and large-file handling.
Pidfd poll registers on the wait queue then signals readability for missing or exited leaders; info validates size, confines hierarchy and copies intersection.
Pidfd control validates codes, serves generation and info directly, and opens selected namespaces after task resolution and access checks with compat normalization.
Pidfd release kills the thread group only with autokill set, skipping kernel threads and workers; exit records grouping and status with ordering.

exports.text: Namespace path, open and query services resolve paths, make close-on-exec read-only descriptors with related lookup, and test or manage membership and references.
Pipe splice drains a pipe into a file under pipe lock via outer and inner entries, with a readability wait that sleeps unlocked.
Truncate, preallocate, chmod, chown and open helpers validate target kind, access and flags then delegate, with finish, no-notify and kernel-open helpers.
Null filesystem registers its own name with context and superblock handling, limited setattr, and file plus directory behavior for an empty immutable root.
Pidfd helpers resolve pid from pidfs files, prepare and register records with fresh numbers, remove them, and free attributes directly or deferred.

hazards.text: Handle liveness without active reference races but revives; pid use needs stashed clearing, inode exclusion, no autokill via handle and paired barriers; codes ENOENT, EINVAL, EPERM, ESRCH, EFAULT, ENOTTY, ENOIOCTLCMD, EOPNOTSUPP, ENOMEM, EAGAIN, ERESTARTSYS, ENOLCK with O_CLOEXEC, O_RDONLY, SPLICE_F_NONBLOCK.
Negative lengths, append-only, lease failures, large-file limits and stale handles guard mutation; notify has silent and checking builds; completion assumes unopened files.
Additional unnamed external helpers for warnings, bitops, cgroup identity, sleep checks, RCU, barriers, compat pointers and cookies are used but owned elsewhere.

invariants.text: Namespace names show type plus bracketed id; fresh inodes take private, mode, ops and serial with reviving reference; pseudo context disables caching.
Namespace controls check extensible size and direction, gate neighbor iteration on visibility, and type-check owner, parent, id, pid and mount queries.
Handles reject parent-qualified or short encodings and store id with type and serial; decode checks liveness, ownership and visibility before returning a path.
Null objects show only dots with seek bound two, unsupported locks, empty reads, fully consumed writes and full-length splice drain.
Pipe feeding drains buffers in order with capping and actor confirmation; inner splice loops wait and feed to ordered wakeup; waiting honors signals and nonblock.
Truncate, access, chroot and extended open validate kind, permission, mount state, control size and large-file rules with revalidation and credential revert.
Pid numbers stay positive skipping zero low halves; attr states track registration and death; inodes derive number and generation; fdinfo and decimal handle empty and overflow.

locks.text: Pid allocation uses a short spinlock; RCU covers hash, task, credential and grouping reads; creation races exit under spin; stability covers namespace capture.
Pipe transfers hold the pipe lock across work except sleeps; path mutations hold mount-write and descriptor truncate holds superblock-write with paired release.

state_machines.text: Neighbor iteration and handle decoding advance through checks, selection or lookup, materialization and publication, failing at each step.
Path truncate flows through permission, notify, holds, lease, security and shared truncate then unwind; descriptor form uses shorter validation.
Access resolves with exec and read-only screens, retries once on stale and reverts creds; open builds flags and installs; close detaches without restart.
Wide pid numbers split into inode plus generation with monotonic allocation; registration, exit, reclaim and lookup branch among empty, error, dead and live.

structs.text: Namespace tables wire ioctl, dentry naming with prune, superblock with evict and path display, stashed handling, export ops and type registration.
Null tables wire seek, iterate, sync, lock and immutable flags with statfs-only superblock, setattr-only inode ops and context teardown.
Pidfs file, inode and dentry tables wire poll with release and control, anonymous attribute helpers with xattr list, and synthetic naming with prune.
Pidfs export with stashing wires encode, decode, permission and open plus stash and release, rejecting short encodings and rebuilding paths; xattrs live only under trusted namespace.
Pid attributes carry presence mask with exit and coredump data, xattr list and reclaim union; ids index in an auto-shrinking hash from one.

Namespace ABI names fixed NS_GET_USERNS, NS_GET_PARENT, NS_GET_NSTYPE, NS_GET_OWNER_UID, NS_GET_MNTNS_ID, NS_GET_ID, NS_GET_PID_FROM_PIDNS, NS_GET_TGID_FROM_PIDNS, NS_GET_PID_IN_PIDNS, NS_GET_TGID_IN_PIDNS and extensible NS_MNT_GET_INFO, NS_MNT_GET_NEXT, NS_MNT_GET_PREV with MNT_NS_INFO_SIZE_VER0, handle NSFS_FID_SIZE_U32_VER0, NSFS_FID_SIZE_U32_LATEST with FILEID_NSFS, FILEID_INVALID, tags CLONE_NEWCGROUP, CLONE_NEWIPC, CLONE_NEWNS, CLONE_NEWNET, CLONE_NEWPID, CLONE_NEWTIME, CLONE_NEWUSER, CLONE_NEWUTS, and NSFS_MAGIC, DCACHE_DONTCACHE, SB_NOUSER, S_IRUGO, FOP_IMMUTABLE.
Other ABI names O_PATH_FLAGS path-only aggregate, PIDFS_PID_DEAD with attribute bits, null size and magic limits, PIDFD_INFO_SUPPORTED families and VALID_FILE_HANDLE_OPEN_FLAGS set.
